allistofearisgod: Gideon Allistofeari came up the line in the rain with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Gideon Allistofeari of the Hegemony and Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri of the Concord watched a broken branch near the Brickworks all morning. Neither side could afford to assume it was only a branch. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Gideon Allistofeari kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
